info.title: VishwAlpha AI Tutor API
info.description:
# VishwAlpha AI Tutor

Personalised NCERT curriculum tutor for Indian school students (Classes 6–12). Students ask questions via chat; the system retrieves relevant textbook context via pgvector RAG and generates pedagogically structured answers using Azure OpenAI.

## Authentication

All protected endpoints require a JWT Bearer token in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

Obtain a token from `POST /auth/login` or `POST /auth/register`. Tokens expire after **7 days** by default.

Admin-only routes (`/admin/*`) use a separate static `X-Admin-Key` header instead of JWT.

## Rate Limits

| Scope | Limit |
|-------|-------|
| Chat endpoints | 30 req / minute |
| Session end | 10 req / minute |
| All other reads | 120 req / minute |

## SSE Streaming

`POST /chat/stream` returns `text/event-stream`. Each line is `data: <json>\n\n`. Event types: `meta`, `token`, `done`, `error`.

post.description: Creates a new student account and returns a JWT `access_token` + `refresh_token`. The `class_num` must be between 6 and 12. Usernames must be 3–50 characters.

400.description: Username/email already taken, or validation error

post.description: Authenticates a student and returns a JWT `access_token` (valid 7 days) and an opaque `refresh_token`. Store both securely. Use the `access_token` in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header for all protected routes.

get.description: Returns the identity of the currently authenticated user (resolved from JWT).

post.description: Exchange a valid, non-expired `refresh_token` for a new `access_token`. The refresh token is opaque (not a JWT) and expires after 7 days.

401.description: Refresh token invalid, expired, or revoked

post.description: Revokes all active refresh tokens for the authenticated user. The `access_token` itself is stateless and will expire naturally.

Sends a student question to the AI tutor and waits for the complete answer. The response includes the full answer text, source citations, topic routing info, and updated cognitive skill metrics. Use `/chat/stream` for real-time token streaming.

Sends a student question to the AI tutor and streams the answer in real-time via Server-Sent Events (`text/event-stream`).

**SSE Event format** (one JSON object per `data:` line):
- `{"type": "meta", "session_id": "...", "is_session_start": true}` — first event
- `{"type": "token", "content": "He"}` — one per token chunk
- `{"type": "done", "sources": [...], "metrics": {...}}` — final event
- `{"type": "error", "detail": "..."}` — only on failure

The frontend should read the stream with `EventSource` or `fetch` + `ReadableStream`, appending `token.content` to the visible message as chunks arrive.

post.summary: End a chat session (triggers deep sync)
post.description: Explicitly ends a chat session and queues the Deep Session Sync in the background. The sync extracts student memory, recalculates weak topics, and updates learning preferences. **Call this when the user navigates away from the chat page or closes the app.** Returns immediately without blocking.

post.summary: Rate a tutor message (thumbs up / down)
post.description: Saves the student's rating on a specific tutor message. Use `rating=1` for thumbs-up, `rating=-1` for thumbs-down, `rating=0` to reset. Optionally include a `feedback_text` reason.

get.description: Returns all conversations for the authenticated student, sorted most-recent-first. Filter by `?subject=Science` or `?study_space_id=<uuid>` to narrow results.

get.summary: Get full message history for a session
get.description: Returns all messages in the conversation (active branch only), along with source citations, topic routing metadata, attachments, and sibling branch info for regenerations. Also returns current cognitive metrics for the session's subject.

404.description: Session not found or belongs to another user

get.summary: Get AI teacher remark for a session
get.description: Returns the latest AI-generated teacher remark (motivational note) for a session.

post.summary: Manually override cognitive metrics for a session
post.description: Updates the raw cognitive metric values for the subject associated with this session. Accepted metric keys: `concept_master_score`, `error_repetition_rate`, `attempt_persistence`, `struggle_recovery_rate`, `practice_intensity`, `learning_velocity`, `knowledge_retention`, `cognitive_thinking_level`, `engagement_frequency`, `assessment_accuracy`. All values 0–100.

404.description: Session not found or has no associated subject

patch.description: Manually sets a custom title for the session (max 120 characters).

post.description: Uses GPT to generate a short, specific title (3–6 words) from the first few messages. Saves it to the DB and returns it. Falls back to the first student message if GPT fails.

patch.description: Activates a specific message branch in the conversation tree (for regeneration navigation). Used when a student clicks ←/→ arrows to switch between AI response variants.

get.description: Full-text search across conversation titles, topic names, and message content. Returns up to `limit` (default 20) matching conversations with a snippet showing context.

post.summary: Create a share link for a conversation
post.description: Creates a frozen read-only snapshot of the conversation and returns a public share token. The share URL format is `/share/<token>`. The snapshot is immutable — later messages are not included.

get.description: Public, no-auth endpoint. Returns the frozen snapshot of a shared conversation by its share token. Returns 404 if the token is invalid, revoked, or expired.

404.description: Share token not found or revoked

get.description:
Returns the student's basic identity.
Pass ?subject=Science to also get the resolved numeric subject_id.
Cache subject_id in the frontend and pass it back in POST /chat/session/end.

Returns cognitive metrics, derived skills, and semantic memory for one subject.
For the richer full profile use GET /student/cognitive/{subject}.

post.description: Manually add a persistent memory fact for this student.

get.description:
FULL per-subject cognitive profile for this student.

Returns:
- 13 raw cognitive metrics (10 core + bloom_level_avg + frustration + confidence)
- 5 derived high-level cognitive skills
- Engagement counters (total_chat_turns, total_quizzes, avg_session_duration_min)
- Aggregated quiz feedback (avg_score, weak_topics, strong_topics, ai_feedback)
- All active memory facts for this subject

This is the primary data source for a per-subject student dashboard card.
The profile row is auto-created on first access (defaults to 50/100 for all metrics).

Returns a summary card for EVERY subject this student has a cognitive
profile for (i.e. every subject they have chatted or taken a quiz in).

Use this to render the multi-subject overview / home dashboard.
Subjects with no profile yet are not included — they appear only after
the student's first chat/quiz turn in that subject.

Returns per-topic mastery data for this student in a given subject.

Each entry shows mastery_level (0-100), bloom_level_reached (1-6),
understood/confused concepts, spaced-repetition schedule, and confidence.

Pass ?chapter_id=<id> to filter to a single chapter.
Use this to render a topic mastery heatmap or list view.
Topics never visited are not included (they appear once first visited via chat/quiz).

Returns a chapter-by-chapter learning path for this student.

Each chapter node contains:
- Chapter title, number, summary, learning_objectives (from NCERT)
- Topics with their individual mastery_level + bloom_level_reached
- Chapter aggregate: avg_mastery, strongest_bloom_level
- Whether any topic has a spaced-repetition review due today

Topics the student has NEVER visited have mastery_level = null (not 0).
Use this to render the subject roadmap / curriculum map view.
Returns all subjects available in the NCERT curriculum for the given `class_num` (6–12).
Returns all chapters for the given class and subject name (e.g. `Science`).

404.description: Subject not found for this class

get.description: Returns all topics for the given class, subject, and chapter title.

post.description:
Generates a personalised quiz (MCQ + theory) for the authenticated student.
Adapts difficulty from their cognitive profile and memory.
Submit a student's answer for a single quiz question (ownership-verified).

Finalises a quiz attempt:
1. Computes final score from all answered questions
2. Generates AI feedback paragraph
3. Updates subject quiz feedback (cumulative record)
4. Applies cognitive metric impact to student profile + memory
5. Updates topic mastery + spaced repetition schedule

get.description: Returns yesterday's session topic for the session-start assignment banner.
Returns the authenticated student's past quiz attempt summaries.
Returns the aggregated quiz feedback record for the authenticated student/subject.

post.summary: Ingest a PDF chapter into the curriculum database
post.description: Uploads and processes a textbook PDF chapter. The pipeline uses PaddleX layout analysis + Tesseract OCR, then calls the Azure OpenAI LLM to structure content into topics, subtopics, and content blocks with enriched summaries. Embeddings are computed and stored in pgvector. **This is a `multipart/form-data` request** — send as a form, not JSON. Requires `X-Admin-Key` header.

404.description: PDF file not found at given path

get.description: Returns ingestion log rows, newest first. Filter by `book_natural_key` and/or `status` (`pending`, `success`, `failed`). Default limit is 50. Requires `X-Admin-Key` header.

schema.title: Response Get Ingestion Log Admin Ingestion Log Get

get.description: Returns all active (non-archived) study spaces for the authenticated student. Filter by `?subject=Science` to only show spaces for a specific subject.

post.description: Creates a new named study space. Supply either `subject_id` (integer) or `subject` (string name). Optionally add `custom_instructions` to tune the tutor's style for this space.

422.description: Validation error (title too long or missing)

patch.description: Updates the title, custom instructions, or archived status of a study space.

404.description: Space not found or belongs to another user

delete.description: Soft-deletes the study space by setting `is_archived=True`. The space is hidden from listings but not removed from the database.

post.description:
Upload an attachment (image or PDF) for curriculum inquiry.
Processes images with Multimodal Vision (transcribing text, math, and diagrams)
and returns metadata ready to attach to ChatRequest.

post.summary: Broadcast a sync event to other devices
post.description: Manually triggers a real-time event broadcast to all other connected devices of the authenticated student. Common event names: `space_switch`, `typing`, `presence`. The `data` dict is forwarded as-is.

get.description: Returns how many devices/tabs the authenticated student currently has connected via WebSocket.
Returns `{status: ok}` when the API is running. No authentication required. Use this endpoint for uptime monitoring.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Leave null to start a new conversation. Subsequent turns must send the UUID returned in the first response.

parent_message_id.title: Parent Message Id
parent_message_id.description: Used for branching/regeneration; omit for normal turns.

study_space_id.title: Study Space Id
study_space_id.description: Attach this chat to a study space.

incognito.title: Incognito
incognito.description: If true, this turn is not saved to history.

question.title: Question
question.description: The student's question in natural language.
examples: Explain Newton's second law of motion with an example.

subject_id.title: Subject Id
subject_id.description: Numeric subject ID. Preferred over subject string.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Subject name, e.g. 'Science'. Used if subject_id is not given.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: List of attachment metadata dicts returned by POST /attachments/upload.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Optional client-generated key to prevent duplicate requests.

QuizQuestionOut.title: QuizQuestionOut
QuizQuestionOut.description: A single question sent to the frontend — correct answer hidden.

QuizSuggestion.title: QuizSuggestion
QuizSuggestion.description: Injected into ChatResponse when AI detects a concept is fully explained.

YesterdayContext.title: YesterdayContext
YesterdayContext.description: Injected into ChatResponse on session start when yesterday's session exists.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Register, login, token refresh, logout, and current-user identity. All protected routes require `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

tags.name: Chat
tags.description: Core tutoring endpoints. Send a question; receive a structured answer (JSON) or a real-time SSE stream of tokens. Rate-limited to 30 req/min.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: Conversation history management: list past sessions, fetch full message history, rename sessions, generate AI titles, branch activation, and sharing.

tags.name: Student
tags.description: Student cognitive profile, per-subject metrics, topic mastery heatmap, and personalised learning-path view.

tags.name: Quiz
tags.description: AI-generated adaptive quizzes. Generate → answer question-by-question → finish to get score + AI feedback + cognitive profile update.

tags.name: Curriculum
tags.description: Public curriculum browse endpoints to populate dropdowns (subjects, chapters, topics). No authentication required.

tags.name: Study Spaces
tags.description: Named per-subject workspaces that group conversations with custom tutor instructions.

tags.name: Attachments
tags.description: Upload images/PDFs. The server runs multimodal vision analysis and returns extracted text + a topic hint ready for use in `POST /chat`.

tags.name: RealTime Sync
tags.description: WebSocket + HTTP endpoints for cross-device state synchronisation (quiz results, study-space changes broadcast to all connected tabs).

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: PDF ingestion and ingestion-log inspection. Protected by `X-Admin-Key` header — **not** a JWT. Admin-only.
